Changing search query params can affect Haravan result filtering. Validate with the live preview URL before declaring fixed.
Cart/variant selection is business-critical. Keep existing product JSON data and add-to-cart flow intact; verify with real variants before marking complete.
A broad button selector can break forms, cart, filters, and quantity controls. Prefer opt-in classes plus targeted legacy aliases.
Changing `--hover` globally may affect links and menu states. Prefer scoped CTA token aliases if broad token changes create regressions.
Some links are true buttons or slider controls. Apply only to text-arrow CTA links, not navigation arrows.
This phase touches settings. Patch only the process group and preserve existing keys so current merchant data remains valid.
Swiper initialization must not duplicate on AJAX or dynamic section loads. Reuse existing init patterns in the theme.
Global background changes can make cards blend into the page. Prefer page wrapper fixes over broad resets when possible.
Container rules are shared widely. Prefer header-scoped fixes if the measured issue is local to nav markup.
Parsing `product.description` can break rich descriptions if delimiters are mishandled. Keep backwards-compatible fallback to plain description.
Tag loop có thể chậm nếu sản phẩm có quá nhiều tag. Haravan thường giới hạn ~50-100 tag/sản phẩm, loop qua là an toàn. | `product.metafields.src.*` giữ nguyên vì là Haravan built-in — không đụng vào.
